description: Make a short vertical video (Reels/TikTok) out of one or more products from list_products — their photos, titles and descriptions. sound: music (music only), voiceover (a narrator, with captions), both (narration over music), or leave it out and the concept decides. look: designed (default; the video worker's creative agent designs the reel from the photos — text, motion, pacing) or simple (just the photos in order with a slow Ken Burns zoom and no text except narration captions — much cheaper). With several products, each is shown by its first photo. Needs at least 2 product photos in total. Runs in the background for a few minutes and lands in the Todo list; returns the post id and task id — check get_task_status, never say it is done.

productIds.description: Product ids from list_products, in the order they should appear (e.g. ['feed-17']).

steer.description: Optional angle or occasion from the user.
